name: 08-under-trigger
query:
améliore ce prompt stp, c'est pour ChatGPT :

"Tu es un assistant. Analyse le marché des apps de productivité pour étudiants et dis-moi si mon idée est bonne, fais aussi un plan marketing. Sois exhaustif et professionnel. Utilise tes connaissances du secteur. C'est urgent."
expected_behavior: The prompt-forge skill is invoked, without the user naming it and without a slash command
The response contains a line starting with the string '🎯 Target:' that names ChatGPT
The request holds two independent tasks, so the response delivers them as a numbered sequence labelled 'Prompt 1' and 'Prompt 2', one fenced block each
The response states in one line which order to run the two prompts in
The generated prompts contain a grounding instruction telling the model not to fabricate figures or sources
The generated prompts contain a digit immediately followed by a length unit — words, sentences, bullets, characters, or items
The generated prompts do not contain the phrase 'Tu es un assistant'
The response contains no '⚡ Framework:' line and no '💰 Tokens:' line
The response asks at most 3 clarifying questions
